summary: Single church. The weekend and weekday Mass times (Sat 8:30 AM and 5 PM; Sun 7:30, 9, 11; Mon, Tue and Thu 6:30 AM; Wed 8:30 AM; no Friday Mass) and Saturday 4:00-4:45 PM Confession are printed identically in the newest and the two older bulletins read, so they are settled. Two questions (R29): the adoration chapel's open hours (Mon-Fri 7 AM-5 PM, Sat 9 AM-5 PM) and the Thursday 5-7 PM Knights of Columbus adoration appear in the Oct 4 and Sep 27 bulletins but not in the newest Oct 11 one; both lean include. The website's mass-times page has a stale 'Mass Schedule Changes' note that disagrees with the bulletins and says nothing of adoration.

SJR EUCHARISTIC ADORATION: Open Mon-Fri 7AM-5PM | Sat 9AM-5PM ... *No Adoration during Masses including Weddings and Funerals*

slots.rationale:
R29: the 'SJR Eucharistic Adoration' box is on page 4 of the Oct 4 and Sep 27 bulletins (and, per history, Sep 20), but the newest bulletin (Oct 11) has Fr. Michael's note on that page instead, and nothing about adoration anywhere else in it. R5: the website's Mass & Confession page does not mention adoration. Leaning to include: three of the last four issues print the same box and the omission looks like one week's layout change, not a change of schedule. Caveats: the box also lists 'NEW Open Hours' (Mon 7AM, Tue 8AM & 2PM, ...), which may be the hours adorers are signed up for, so the 7-5 range is the box's own heading; it says 'Coming Soon: Chapel open until 7PM Mon-Fri'; and 'No Adoration during Masses', which would break up the Wed 8:30 AM Mass hour.

Review 2026-10-22: Carry forward the repeated chapel hours provisionally if the owner adopts a carry-forward rule. Preserve “No Adoration during Masses including Weddings and Funerals”; the offered continuous intervals currently omit that important qualification.
